comparison.objective: Store a board behind a leaning stack without removing the existing boards.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a spring-closing gap open with one arm while inserting a rigid board with the other.
comparison.success_condition: Board correctly behind the stack; all boards supported in the rack, released, stable, and never removed.
comparison.reason: The candidate transfers a recirculating-bearing block across a butted rail–jig interface while preserving free balls. Holding boards aside and inserting another board does not test continuous raceway support or rolling-element containment.
